title: Optimize chunked speculative prefill + decode stage overlap with kernel scheduler and KV cache improvements
author: Aiden Chen
description: Motivation: reduce end-to-end latency and improve throughput for long-context workloads by tightening the integration between chunked prefill, speculative prefill, and decode-stage overlap. This PR introduces a kernel-aware scheduler that prioritizes alignment of chunk boundaries with fast-path kernels, a compact KV cache layout to reduce host–device copy overhead for partial prefill reuse, and conservative speculative prefill heuristics to reduce wasted compute. Changes are designed to be opt-in via runtime config and include feature flags for per-model heuristics. The main goals are lower p99 latency for mixed prefilling + decode workloads, better GPU utilization for small-to-medium batch shapes, and reduced transient memory pressure during aggressive overlap. Results: in internal perf lab we measured 10-18% p99 latency reduction on 2k-token Llama-like models with 4-8 concurrent streams and up to 1.3x throughput for 4-stream throughput tests; KV cache memory usage dropped ~20% for typical batch shapes. Backwards compatible defaults preserved; no changes to API surface. Implementation notes: add KernelScheduler component, introduce CompactKVBuffer and an allocator that prefers device-resident tiled slices, change prefill orchestration to emit speculative candidate chunks and a lightweight cancellation path for wasted speculative work, and wire continuous batching to respect new scheduling priorities. Testing: unit tests for kernel selection heuristics, integration perf harnesses updated, e2e CI that runs short throughput/latency harness. Rollout: feature-flagged rollout with canary on dedicated clusters, telemetry added to observe speculative abort rate, kernel hot-path hit rate, and KV copy volume.

review_comments: Priya Narang: Nice work. Can you quantify speculative abort rate and add a metric for 'speculative_wasted_ms' so ops can monitor?
Aiden Chen (author): Added telemetry for speculative aborts and a histogram for wasted_ms. Added conservative default to keep abort <10% observed in lab.
Marta Lopez: Kernel selection looks good. Please add a comment about fallback ordering when chunk boundaries misalign (done).
Ethan Park: Minor nit on naming in CompactKVBuffer; prefer 'TileAllocator' for clarity (renamed). Also asked to ensure allocator is NUMA-friendly on multi-socket hosts.
Aiden Chen: Addressed nits, added NUMA hint support behind flag. Verified benchmarks after changes.
release_notes: Performance: improved prefill+decode latency and throughput via kernel-aware scheduling, compact KV cache, and speculative prefill heuristics. Ops: new telemetry for speculative aborts and kernel hot-path hit rate. Rollout: feature-flagged; enable via runtime flag 'prefill_decode_optim_v1'.
